profile.aboutYou: Principal soloist specializing in Neoclassical and Contemporary repertoire. Alumna of the Royal Danish Ballet and guest performer across major European opera houses.

interviewQuestions.question: What inspires you as a dancer?
interviewQuestions.answer: I am inspired by storytelling through movement and the emotional connection between music and dance. I always try to bring authenticity nd depth to every performance.

interviewQuestions.question: How do you prepare for a new role?
interviewQuestions.answer: I start by researching the character and the choreography in depth. I also work closely with the artistic team to understand their vision and bring my own interpretation to the role.
